headline: Nellie Bly races around the world
post_facts: Reporter for the New York World
Met Jules Verne on the way

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen eighty-nine... a reporter set out to race around the world.

scenes.label: Nellie Bly
scenes.caption: The reporter in 1889
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Nellie Bly wanted to beat the eighty days of Jules Verne's novel.

scenes.label: to circle the globe, with one small bag
scenes.text: [calmly] She did it in seventy-two days, with one small bag.

scenes.caption: Board game made from her trip
scenes.title: She even met Jules Verne
A race against a rival
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] A rival, Elizabeth Bisland, raced the other way... Bly won.

scenes.title: Could you travel with just one bag?
scenes.text: [gently] Could you travel the world with just one bag?
[warmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
